quest.name: A Little Firewood
quest.description: Mara needs firewood to keep the settlement warm.

talk.text: Bring me 10 wood and I will pay 100 caps. Interested?

stage.journal: Bring 10 wood to Mara and ask her to {finish} the job.

objective.reply: That will keep us warm. Here are your caps.

ending.journal: Mara received the firewood and paid you 100 caps.

reply.text: Have you brought 10 wood? Say {finish} when you are ready.
Thanks for the firewood. The job is finished.
